about: The skill families drawn in the library map (docs/launch/skill-families.svg) and one family card each (docs/launch/families/). The grouping is for the map only; on disk the skills sit in two folders, skills/ (design) and copy-skills/ (copywriting). Each family card shows one gallery example from docs/before-after/: screenshots for a build task, or a few lines quoted word for word from the stored answers for a text task. scripts/make_share_images.py checks that every listed skill is in exactly one family and that every quoted line is in the stored answer.

families.name: Look and type
families.changes: Color, fonts, text setting and marks, so a page or logo looks made for its product.

families.name: Layout and emphasis
families.changes: What sits where, what reads first and how the page holds up on any screen.

families.name: Charts and tables
families.changes: Honest axes, the right chart for the question, and tables that line up and read.

with: This is ready to send. The chart is honest, and I only have a few optional tweaks.

families.name: Product behavior
families.changes: How screens, forms, motion and agents act, and every state a real user meets.

families.name: Research and teaching
families.changes: Finding out what people need, teaching them, and judging a design with ranked findings.

families.name: Selling and presenting
